outcome: Relationship between 3DPD indices and placental morphometry
Impact of machine settings and physical characteristics on 3DPD indices
cohort: 112 pregnant women: 84 with normal pregnancies and 28 with PE and/or IUGR
finding: This study aims to evaluate the relationship between 3DPD indices and placental morphometry, the impact of machine settings and physical characteristics on 3DPD indices, and physio-pathological placental vascularisation patterns in pregnant women with and without PE and/or IUGR.
